mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, name, type, company_name, contact, email, tel_number, country, province, city, district , address_first, address_second, zip_code,province_name,city_name,district_name,country_name
mapper.select: SELECT la.id, la.create_user_id, la.create_user_name, la.create_time, la.update_user_id, la.update_user_name, la.update_time, la.version, la.is_deleted, la.name, la.type, la.company_name, la.contact, la.email, la.tel_number, la.country, la.address_first, la.address_second, la.zip_code, la.province_name, la.city_name, la.district_name, la.country_name, la.address_id, lca.shop_id FROM logistics_channel_address lca LEFT JOIN logistics_address la ON la.ID = lca.address_id AND la.is_deleted=false WHERE lca.logistics_channel_id=#{channelId} AND lca.is_deleted=false ORDER BY la.create_time DESC

select id,name,address_id from ( select la.id, la.name, la.address_id from logistics_address la where la.is_deleted = false
and la.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%')
and la.type=#{params.type}
order by
case when la.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when la.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when la.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , la.name,
la.update_time desc ) wls
